# PARALLAX 2027 — ISTE State Student Convention Portal

> Official convention and event registration portal for **PARALLAX 2027**, the **ISTE State Student Convention** hosted by the **ISTE Student Chapter at NSS College of Engineering (NSSCE), Palakkad, Kerala**. Designed and built by [Midhun K M](https://midhunkm.pages.dev).

PARALLAX is the flagship ISTE student convention portal for discovering **ISTE events**, competitions, workshops, hackathons, passes, schedules, and campus venue details.

## Core Information

- **Convention Name**: PARALLAX 2027 (ISTE State Student Convention)
- **Host Institution**: NSS College of Engineering (NSSCE), Palakkad, Kerala, India
- **Organizing Body**: ISTE Student Chapter, NSSCE (Indian Society for Technical Education)
- **Platform Developer / Author**: [Midhun K M](https://midhunkm.pages.dev)
- **Contact Email**: iste@nssce.ac.in

## Public Pages

- [Home](/) — Overview of PARALLAX 2027 and the ISTE State Student Convention.
- [Events](/events) — Full catalog of ISTE events, technical competitions, workshops, and hackathons with rules, prize pools, and registration.
- [Convention Pass](/pass) — 2-day convention passes (ISTE Member, Standard, and Polytechnic tiers) with included event allowances, lunch, delegate kit, and official certificate.
- [Schedule](/schedule) — Day-by-day programme, timings, and venue rooms.
- [Venue & Travel](/venue) — NSS College of Engineering, Palakkad campus directions, map, and travel information.
- [About](/about) — About ISTE NSSCE and the PARALLAX convention.
- [FAQ](/faq) — Frequently asked questions about passes, ISTE membership discounts, team registration, and check-in.
- [Meet the Team](/team) — Organizing committee and Web-Dev Team (including [Midhun K M](https://midhunkm.pages.dev)).
- [Contact](/contact) — Direct support desk and inquiry form for participants and institutions.

## Portal Capabilities

- **One-Click Google Sign-In**: Secure participant authentication.
- **Pass & Event Registration**: Unified checkout powered by Razorpay with instant confirmation.
- **Team Coordination**: Create teams, share invite codes, and manage event rosters.
- **Digital QR Pass & Receipts**: Downloadable Parallax ID card with QR check-in and fee receipts.
